title: Analytics & Tracking
description: Set up GA4, conversion events, and marketing pixels with privacy-conscious defaults.

steps.title: Create GA4 Property
steps.instructions: Create a GA4 property for the client domain. Use the client's Google account or transfer ownership after setup.

steps.title: Install GA4 Tag
steps.instructions: Add GA4 via Google Tag Manager or the SEO/analytics plugin. Avoid duplicate tags from theme + plugin + GTM.

steps.title: Define Key Conversions
steps.instructions: Mark form submissions, phone clicks, brochure downloads, and purchase events as conversions in GA4.

steps.title: Filter Internal Traffic
steps.instructions: Exclude agency office IPs and logged-in admin preview traffic from analytics reports.

steps.title: Wire Cookie Consent
steps.instructions: Ensure analytics and ad pixels respect consent mode / cookie banner choices before firing on first visit.

steps.title: Verify Realtime Data
steps.instructions: Open GA4 Realtime while browsing the site in an incognito window. Confirm page_view and conversion events appear.
